item.title: Virginia moves 2026 primary election from June to August
item.description: Virginia is moving the primary date for the 2026 elections from June to August.Virginia primaries delayedThe Virginia Department of Elections announced the change on Tuesday. The primary for the 2026 November General Election will now be held on Aug. 4. The primary was originally scheduled for June 16.There will be no primary elections on June 16.According to the DOE, the date was pushed back because of the recently-passed House Bill 29. item.title: Canadian man sentenced to 10 years after traveling to Virginia to meet minor: prosecutors
item.description: A federal judge sentenced a Toronto man to 10 years in prison for attempted coercion and enticement of what he thought was a minor in Virginia, according to the U.S. Attorney’s Office.
